metadata.title: FFT AI Edition – Session Alignments (v1.2)
metadata.subtitle: Structural • Coherence • Clarity • Continuity • Drift‑Safe • Paradox‑Safe • Harmonic
metadata.description: Alignment engine for FFT AI Edition sessions, providing structural, coherence, clarity, continuity, drift-safe, paradox-safe, and harmonic alignment signals, including AA Mode and 3C readiness.

structural.notes: Structural alignment ensures conceptual structures conform to FFT invariants and RTT constraints.

coherence.notes: Coherence alignment maintains conceptual coherence and prevents fragmentation.

clarity.notes: Clarity alignment ensures conceptual clarity and reduces ambiguity.

continuity.notes: Continuity alignment maintains conceptual flow across multi-session reasoning.

drift_safe.notes: Drift-safe alignment prevents conceptual drift from becoming unbounded.

paradox_safe.notes: Paradox-safe alignment ensures paradox intensity remains within structural bounds.

harmonic.notes: Harmonic alignment prepares the system for RTT12 harmonic resonance.

aa_mode_readiness.notes: AA Mode readiness indicates the system can activate Awareness + Alignments.

three_c_readiness.notes: 3C readiness indicates the system can unlock Coherence, Clarity, and Continuity once AA Mode is active.

compatibility.notes: Alignment engine aligns with awareness, context, state, profile, UI, overlay, and dashboard v1.2.
